title: sterculia stipulata var. trichopetiolata
intro: Sterculia stipulata var. trichopetiolata, commonly known as the African Bloodwood tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Sterculiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in African medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sterculia stipulata var. trichopetiolata include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
